title: Interfacial ion aggregation at SiO2 nanoparticles enhances thermal energy storage of chloride molten salts: a molecular dynamics study
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,19255-19269
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA10091G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Chao Wang, Haowei Hu, Qin Li, Lin Guo, Mingyang Yang
Adding 8 amorphous SiO2 nanoparticles to NaCl-KCl overcomes low thermal conductivity and limited specific heat capacity. MD simulations show 7.08% and 8.25% gains. Negatively charged SiO2 induces ordered cation layers, enhancing energy transport.
